output.answer_markdown: The passages do not report wages expense (or any wage/payroll line) for Ulta Beauty, so I cannot say whether it rose or fell as a percent of net sales in FY2023. They give only total SG&A as a percent-of-sales input (SG&A of $2,395.3 million on net sales of $10,208.6 million for the fiscal year ended January 28, 2023) [1][3], and SG&A is not wages. They also do not include the fiscal year ended February 3, 2024 results that would correspond to the 10-K labelled FY2023.
